guidebook.intro: Nyumbani: vyumba, vitu vilivyopo na visivyokuwepo, na rangi.

tips.title: “In”, “on”, “under”
body: Kiswahili hutumia **-ni** na **juu ya**, **chini ya**. Kiingereza kina maneno mafupi: **in the kitchen** (jikoni), **on the table** (mezani, juu ya meza), **under the bed** (chini ya kitanda).
Mara nyingi tumia **the** kabla ya kitu: **The tea is on the table.**

tips.title: “There is” na “there are”
body: **Kuna** ni **there is** kwa kitu kimoja, na **there are** kwa vingi: **There is a chair.** **There are three rooms.**
**Hakuna** ni **there isn’t** au **there aren’t**: **There is no water.** (Hakuna maji.)

tips.title: Rangi huja kabla ya kitu
body: Kiswahili husema **nyumba nyeupe** (kitu kisha rangi). Kiingereza hugeuza: **a white house**, **a red door**.
Rangi haibadiliki kwa wingi: **a red car**, **two red cars**. Kuuliza: **What colour is it?** (Ni rangi gani?)

culture.title: Karibu nyumbani
body: Mgeni akibisha hodi, kwa Kiingereza unasema **Come in!** au **Welcome!** Kumkaribisha kukaa: **Please sit down.** Kumpa kinywaji: **Would you like some tea?**
